summary: DjangoLux 1.15.3 security runtime: private stored files, unsaved-changes prompts, personal table columns and the Operations panel.
highlights: Updated the application framework to DjangoLux 1.15.3, a security release.
Stored files are private: attachments and receipts open only for signed-in users who may see the record; storefront images stay public.
Closing an add or edit window with unsaved changes asks whether to save, discard or go back; Save submits the form once.
Arrange columns lets each user reorder table columns and show or hide them with the eye on each header.
Options > Operations checks the deployment, applies repairs, restarts services and shows their logs.
The Updates card settles after a check, shows each release's own notes and reloads after Finish.
The update progress page now comes from Composer and returns you to the page you were on.
New Composer wrapper: ./start.sh update refreshes the deployer before updating the stack.
